category_edits.rationale: Replace the 2d GELU feed-forward path with SwiGLU in every category's BERT4Rec blocks. Two parallel d-to-2d projections provide content-dependent gating while preserving bidirectional attention, pre-norm residuals, embeddings, masking, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, keeping checkpoint construction consistent. Explicit forward dispatch ensures training and inference both use SwiGLU.

change_summary: Use SwiGLU feed-forward blocks across all four independently trained category models, with matching inference through the existing predictor import.
